overall_reason: A fluid Webflow system: spacing and type scale with the viewport (8.5, 16.5, 33.5px gaps; --text--h1 to --text--h6 tokens) and colour is a short named palette (--color--dark-green, --color--lime); the drift is display sizes in near pairs and type tokens that rules mostly bypass.

score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY passes on colour and spacing; T-DRIFT-PAIRS finds display sizes in near pairs and T-HARDCODE finds font sizes typed past the declared type tokens (TOK-010, TOK-006).

findings.evidence: Display text renders in near pairs: 60 and 62.5px, 70 and 72.5px, 93.5 and 97.5px, 106 and 110px (values.1440.font_size near_duplicates); the sweep's type_ladder hit counts 19 sizes.
findings.before: 106 and 110px for impact headlines in sibling sections
findings.after: One impact size per level from the --text--impact token
findings.why: A 4% difference between sibling headlines reads as a mistake, not a level.

findings.evidence: The page declares --text--h1 to --text--h6, --text--eyebrow and --text--impact, but only 8 font-size declarations reference a token against 59 literals and 84 utility literals; 21 font-size and 52 spacing literals equal a token's value (declarations.literal_retypes_a_token_value).
findings.before: Font sizes retyped beside the type tokens
findings.after: Headings, eyebrows and buttons reference the --text-- tokens
findings.why: Type tokens that rules bypass cannot keep the scale in step when it changes.

findings.evidence: Muted text pairs #b4b8a5 (11 elements) with #b9bbad (4) (values.1440.colour_text near_duplicates, 0.014 OKLab).
findings.after: One muted-text token from the green-grey palette
findings.why: Two greys a hair apart split one role.

strengths: Spacing follows one fluid scale that doubles (8.5, 16.5, 33.5px at 1440) and 56% of spacing declarations reference tokens.
Colour is a named palette (--color--dark-green, its two tints, --color--lime, --color--cream) used on 9 text colours in total.
One easing and one duration token (--cubic-default, --duration-default) carry 93% of transitions.
not_investigated: inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles only
token source files behind the shipped CSS (Sass, JSON tokens, Figma variables): only the shipped CSS was read
states the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus): their values are not in the table
T-THEME-PARITY: no second theme in the stylesheet
T-FRAMEWORK-FIT: no framework scale in use (Webflow class names only)
the 4px-based scale fit is not meaningful here: the spacing is fluid, so share_on_4px 0.059 says nothing about the system
